details:
* OpenJDK 8u514 release (jdk8u514-ga == jdk8u514-b01).
     Release notes:
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-10-20
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-10-21
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-10-24
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-08-18
     - Security fixes (8u514, advisory 2026-11-17):
       + CVE-2026-114939: security-libs/org.ietf.jgss
       + CVE-2026-114940: security-libs/javax.net.ssl
       + CVE-2026-114943: hotspot/runtime
       + CVE-2026-114944: core-svc/java.lang.management
       + CVE-2026-114946: hotspot/compiler

       update:
       + CVE-2026-91403: java.security CA distrust (JDK-8395142)
       + CVE-2026-114820: java.security CA certificate improvements
         (JDK-8395690, advisory 2026-10-24); on Debian/Ubuntu the
         runtime trust anchors come from ca-certificates via
         ca-certificates-java
